title: Should sage stop sending pages through the Claude app's file tool?

blocks.label: Where this is
blocks.text: Release 1.0 › single task: one way to show visuals in every app › step: investigate

blocks.label: What you approve
blocks.text: How pages reach you in the Claude desktop app. Today I sometimes send a page with Claude's file tool, which can show it inside the chat.

blocks.label: The one real choice in it
blocks.text: A page inside the chat, or a page that never leaves your Mac. The file tool sends a copy through Anthropic's servers. A link to the page on your Mac sends nothing.

head: Answer
What happens next
Cost
rows: **Stop: use the link to your Mac only**
Every page reaches you as the same link and file path, in Claude and in Codex. A click opens it beside the chat. No copy leaves your Mac.
No extra build: the link is part of the planned page link work (3 to 7 h of agent time, estimate).
Keep the file tool as an extra for some pages
Some pages also open inside the Claude chat. Codex has no match, so the two apps differ.
Small: one more rule for the chief. A copy of each of those pages goes through Anthropic's servers.

blocks.label: If you do not answer
blocks.text: The page link build uses my pick. You can change the answer until that pull request merges.

blocks.label: Needed by
blocks.text: Before the page link build starts. Nothing waits for it now.

blocks.label: Judged by
blocks.text: Your rule that pages stay on your Mac; the same view in Claude and Codex.

blocks.label: The bad side of my pick
blocks.text: In the Claude app, a page opens beside the chat, not inside it.

blocks.label: After you answer
blocks.text: I say in one line what I recorded, for example “Recorded: stop; pages go by link only.”
